observations: Photo 0: Open laptop with screen and keyboard covered in plastic wrap. HP logo visible below screen. Keyboard has black keys, trackpad with two buttons. Blue Intel sticker on lower right of palm rest. Screen reflects surroundings, no visible display.
Photo 1: Closed laptop from top view, covered in plastic wrap. HP logo centered on lid. Background is purple and black patterned surface.

Photo 2: Open laptop from front angle, similar to photo 0. Screen still covered in plastic, reflecting surroundings. Keyboard and trackpad visible. Intel sticker present. Plastic wrap shows creases and smudges.

claims.claim: Durable and wide screen laptop for all computer related tasks
claims.evidence: Photos show plastic wrap and no screen activity; durability and performance cannot be assessed remotely. 'Wide screen' is subjective and not measurable from photos.

risks.risk: Screen may be cracked or damaged under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screen without plastic wrap, showing full display and any cracks or dead pixels.

risks.risk: Laptop may not power on or have functional components
risks.proof: Video clip showing laptop turning on, booting, and displaying a working desktop.

risks.risk: Keyboard or trackpad may be non-functional
risks.proof: Video clip showing keys being pressed and trackpad being used with cursor movement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional input devices

risks.risk: Plastic wrap may be old or damaged, indicating prior use or storage issues
risks.proof: Photo of laptop without plastic wrap, showing condition of casing, hinges, and ports.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly used or worn

proof_requests: Video clip of laptop turning on and showing a working desktop.
Close-up photo of screen without plastic wrap.
Photo of laptop without plastic wrap, showing all sides, ports, and hinges.
Video clip showing keyboard and trackpad functionality.
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as an HP model, but critical functional and condition details are hidden by plastic wrap. Without proof of power, screen functionality, and physical condition, it cannot be priced accurately. The claims about durability and performance are unverifiable remotely.
